channel.title: North Wales Chronicle - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from North Wales Chronicle (northwaleschronicle.co.uk)

item.title: World-music festival returns with line-up to celebrate 30 years in Dolgellau
item.description: Sesiwn Fawr Dolgellau is returning with a line-up that celebrates over three decades of world music in Wales.

item.title: Two RSPCA animal rescue officers prepare to ride the world's fastest zipline
item.description: Two RSPCA animal rescue officers are preparing to ride the world’s fastest zipline.

item.title: Man dubbed ‘employee from hell’ loses more claims made against a Gwynedd town council
item.description: A man who previously lost an employment tribunal against a town council in Gwynedd has had further claims against the organisation dismissed.

item.title: Calls for ‘urgent action’ after North Wales cardiology wait times increase
item.description: Concerns have been raised about the increase in waits for cardiology diagnostic appointments in North Wales.

item.title: Anglesey garage at risk of closure due to company's 'significant' financial losses
item.description: Jobs are on the line and at risk of redundancy as a nationwide garage looks set to close down its premises on Anglesey.

item.title: Men aged 19 and 20 tragically found dead after going missing on Yr Wyddfa named
item.description: The bodies of Eddie Hill, 20, and Jayden Long, 19, from Norfolk, were located in the Eryri mountain range during searches for the two missing men.

item.title: Family park near Bangor launches one of its biggest recruitment drives
item.description: The attraction, near Bangor, operated by Continuum Attractions, is seeking enthusiastic team members to join their team until November.

item.title: Battle for the Beaumaris Castle car park as councils clash over control
item.description: Beaumaris Town Council is fighting to keep control of the Castle Car Park, warning that losing the income could force the closure of the town’s historic gaol and courthouse as Anglesey County Council prepares to rule on the site’s future.

item.title: New BBC emotional wilderness show fronted by Bear Grylls takes in Caernarfon
item.description: Filming locations in North Wales for the show included Caernarfon and the Llŷn Peninsula.

item.title: Historic North Wales hotel in stunning location returns 'unexpectedly' to the market
item.description: The accommodation was built in 1827 and became a popular venue due to its location adjacent to the famous chain bridge over the River Dee.
